{{- /* The page body as standalone Markdown, for the per-page index.md (_default/single.markdown.md, _default/list.markdown.md, reference/*.markdown.md). It is what the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/) calls LLM-friendly content: the same Markdown the author wrote, with everything Hugo-specific resolved. - Shortcodes are rendered (.RenderShortcodes) with their `markdown` templates (shortcodes/.markdown.md). A shortcode without one falls back to its .html template. - Generator comments ("Do not edit this file" on API reference pages) are dropped, CRLF line ends become LF and runs of blank lines collapse to one. - api-documenter's HTML tables (symbol lists, properties, parameters) become Markdown tables (md/tables.html). Hand-written HTML in guides is left as written. - In a guide, a code span naming an API symbol (`IMeasure`) links to its reference page, as on the HTML page (md/code-links.html). Generated reference pages carry their own links. - In a guide, each `##`–`######` heading links to its own section on the web page, with the id Hugo rendered, so a reader (or an agent) can cite the section by copying the link. - Every page-relative (`../quickstart/`) and root-relative (`/latest/api-reference/...`, which is also what relref returns) link or image becomes an absolute URL, because the file is read outside the site or pasted into a prompt, where a relative path has no base. A link to a page that has a Markdown version points to that version (md/links.html). Links with a scheme (https:, mailto:) and in-page anchors are kept. Expects: the page. Returns the Markdown string (never prints: this is an .html template, and printing from it would HTML-escape the text). */ -}} {{- $u := urls.Parse .Permalink -}} {{- $base := printf "%s/" (strings.TrimSuffix "/" (urls.Parse site.BaseURL).Path) -}} {{- $links := partialCached "md/links.html" site -}} {{- /* A build without baseURL (a laptop `hugo` run) has no host; the links stay root-relative then. `hugo server` has a host but no scheme (//localhost:1313/): the links are protocol-relative. */ -}} {{- $origin := "" -}} {{- with $u.Host }}{{ $origin = printf "%s//%s" (cond (ne $u.Scheme "") (printf "%s:" $u.Scheme) "") . }}{{ end -}} {{- /* api-documenter writes CRLF line ends; everything below splits on "\n". */ -}} {{- $out := replace (.RenderShortcodes | string) "\r\n" "\n" -}} {{- $out = replaceRE `(?s)` "" $out -}} {{- $out = partial "md/tables.html" $out -}} {{- if ne .Params.source "api-documenter" }}{{ $out = partial "md/code-links.html" (dict "page" . "text" $out) }}{{ end -}} {{- /* `](target)` and `](target "title")`; the title, if any, is kept as written. */ -}} {{- range findRESubmatch `\]\(([^)\s]+)((?:\s+"[^"]*")?)\)` $out -}} {{- $href := index . 1 -}} {{- $title := index . 2 -}} {{- $keep := or (findRE `^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:` $href) (hasPrefix $href "#") -}} {{- if not $keep -}} {{- $path := $href -}} {{- $fragment := "" -}} {{- with findRESubmatch `^([^#]*)(#.*)$` $href -}} {{- $path = index (index . 0) 1 -}} {{- $fragment = index (index . 0) 2 -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Root-relative: under the site's base path. relref includes that path already when the site does not canonify URLs (/docs/latest/...), and leaves it out when it does (/latest/...). */ -}} {{- $dir := $u.Path -}} {{- if hasPrefix $path "/" -}} {{- $dir = cond (and (ne $base "/") (hasPrefix $path $base)) "/" $base -}} {{- end -}} {{- $joined := path.Clean (path.Join $dir $path) -}} {{- if and (hasSuffix $path "/") (ne $joined "/") -}}{{- $joined = printf "%s/" $joined -}}{{- end -}} {{- $target := printf "%s%s" $joined $fragment -}} {{- /* A link written without the trailing slash (`/latest/visualisations/pie-chart`) is the same page. A member's section already carries its fragment; any other fragment is kept. */ -}} {{- with or (index $links $joined) (index $links (printf "%s/" $joined)) -}} {{- $target = cond (strings.Contains . "#") . (printf "%s%s" . $fragment) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out = replace $out (printf "](%s%s)" $href $title) (printf "](%s%s%s)" $origin $target $title) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* In a guide, each `##`–`######` heading becomes a link to its section on the web page (`## [Title](https://…/page/#id)`), so an agent can cite a section by copying the link instead of guessing its anchor. The id is the one Hugo rendered (.Fragments), so it matches the HTML exactly. A heading is linked only when its text (md/heading-key.html) occurs once among the rendered headings and once among the heading lines here, so a heading-looking line that isn't one (inside raw HTML, say) never takes a real heading's link; a heading that already holds a link is left alone. `{#custom-id}` links to that id, and the attribute is dropped. Fenced code is skipped the way CommonMark reads fences: up to 3 spaces of indent, closed by the same character, at least as long, alone on its line. Runs after the link pass above, which would otherwise turn the link into the Markdown copy's. */ -}} {{- if ne .Params.source "api-documenter" -}} {{- $idByKey := dict -}} {{- $rendered := dict -}} {{- range $id, $h := .Fragments.HeadingsMap -}} {{- $key := partial "md/heading-key.html" (dict "text" $h.Title "html" true) -}} {{- $rendered = merge $rendered (dict $key (add (index $rendered $key | default 0) 1)) -}} {{- $idByKey = merge $idByKey (dict $key $id) -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Pass 1: the heading lines outside fenced code, and how often each key occurs. */ -}} {{- $rows := slice -}} {{- $written := dict -}} {{- $fenceChar := "" -}} {{- $fenceLen := 0 -}} {{- range split $out "\n" -}} {{- $row := dict "line" . -}} {{- $fenceLine := findRESubmatch `^ {0,3}(\x60{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$` . 1 -}} {{- if $fenceLine -}} {{- $run := index (index $fenceLine 0) 1 -}} {{- $rest := index (index $fenceLine 0) 2 -}} {{- $char := substr $run 0 1 -}} {{- if eq $fenceChar "" -}} {{- if not (and (eq $char "`") (strings.Contains $rest "`")) -}} {{- $fenceChar = $char -}} {{- $fenceLen = len $run -}} {{- end -}} {{- else if and (eq $char $fenceChar) (ge (len $run) $fenceLen) (eq (strings.TrimSpace $rest) "") -}} {{- $fenceChar = "" -}} {{- end -}} {{- else if eq $fenceChar "" -}} {{- with findRESubmatch `^(#{2,6})\s+(.+?)(?:\s+#+)?\s*$` . 1 -}} {{- $text := index (index . 0) 2 -}} {{- $custom := "" -}} {{- with findRESubmatch `^(.*?)\s*\{#([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\}$` $text 1 -}} {{- $text = index (index . 0) 1 -}} {{- $custom = index (index . 0) 2 -}} {{- end -}} {{- $key := partial "md/heading-key.html" (dict "text" $text "html" false) -}} {{- $written = merge $written (dict $key (add (index $written $key | default 0) 1)) -}} {{- $row = dict "line" $row.line "hashes" (index (index . 0) 1) "text" $text "custom" $custom "key" $key -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $rows = $rows | append $row -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Pass 2: link the headings that match exactly one rendered heading. */ -}} {{- $lines := slice -}} {{- range $row := $rows -}} {{- $line := $row.line -}} {{- if and $row.hashes (not (strings.Contains $row.text "](")) -}} {{- $id := "" -}} {{- if $row.custom -}} {{- if index $.Fragments.HeadingsMap $row.custom }}{{ $id = $row.custom }}{{ end -}} {{- else if and (eq (index $rendered $row.key) 1) (eq (index $written $row.key) 1) -}} {{- $id = index $idByKey $row.key -}} {{- end -}} {{- if $id -}} {{- $line = printf "%s [%s](%s#%s)" $row.hashes $row.text $.Permalink $id -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $lines = $lines | append $line -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out = delimit $lines "\n" -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Removed comments and shortcodes leave runs of blank lines; one is enough. */ -}} {{- return trim (replaceRE `\n[ \t]*(\n[ \t]*)+\n` "\n\n" $out) " \n" -}}
